passages.text: Bazzania is a genus of liverwort in the family Lepidoziaceae. The name Bazzania is in honour of Matteo Bazzani (1674–1749), an Italian botanist and professor of Anatomy from the University of Bologna.

Species 
{{As of|2024|November}}, there were 258 species accepted by The Bryophyte Nomenclator, edited by John C. Brinda and John J. Atwood, listed here.
